title: In talking to @bonstewart I was using the word resilient more in terms of the web and artifacts (https://resilientwebdesign.com), Bonnie meant it more
summary: In talking to @bonstewart I was using the word resilient more in terms of the web and artifacts (https://resilientwebdesign.com), Bonnie meant it more in terms of communities. Maybe #ProSocialWeb is realization that these are not different.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: In talking to @bonstewart I was using the word resilient more in terms of the web and artifacts (https://resilientwebdesign.com), Bonnie meant it more in terms of communities. Maybe #ProSocialWeb is realization that these are not different.
